findings.claim: A Smart Collection queue starts with loop on, while a collection queue starts with loop off, although the spec asks that the loop toggle work as it does for a collection.
findings.impact: A user who has never touched the loop toggle gets a looping Smart Collection queue but a non-looping collection queue. The shared localStorage key means the first toggle in either surface changes both, so the default difference is visible and surprising.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/CollectionPanel.tsx: getLoop() returns stored ?? false, while the new getSmartLoop() returns stored ?? true; SmartQueuePanel uses getSmartLoop as its initial state. Both read LOOP_KEY 'collection-loop'.
findings.repro: Not reproduced; read of the defaults only. Clear localStorage, open a collection queue (loop OFF) and a Smart Collection queue (loop ON).

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant names the default. Step 5 says the loop toggle works as for a collection, and the default departs from that without being written down.

findings.proposed_fix: Either use the collection default (false) for the Smart Collection queue, or add the loop-on default to SPEC-CORE-109 step 5 so the difference is intentional.

getSemanticAvailability clears _cached before refetching when no fetch is in flight; a concurrent caller sharing the in-flight promise is unaffected.

fetchSemanticHits now returns a status field on ok:false responses. A 200 with available:false yields status 200 and therefore complete:false in the evaluator. The spec says any other ok:false is complete:false, so this matches the spec, but it can make Play refuse where the page shows listing-only results if the server ever answers available:false for an enabled drive.
